title: Growing Up
grammarNote: The imperfect tense (era, tenía, íbamos, jugaba) describes habitual actions, ongoing states, ages, and background scenery in the past — 'what things were like' or 'what used to happen.' The preterite marks a single completed event, often one that interrupts the imperfect backdrop, frequently signaled by 'mientras... cuando...' or 'de repente.'

phrases.target: Cuando era niño, vivía en un pueblo pequeño
phrases.native: When I was a kid, I lived in a small town
phrases.phonetic: KWAN-doh EH-rah NEE-nyoh, vee-VEE-ah en oon PWEH-bloh peh-KEH-nyoh
phrases.vocabularyIntro: 'Era' (imperfect of 'ser') sets up background description — age, identity, ongoing state — rather than a single finished event.

exampleSentence.target: Cuando era niño, vivía en un pueblo pequeño cerca de Guadalajara.
exampleSentence.native: When I was a kid, I lived in a small town near Guadalajara.

phrases.grammarNote: 'Era' and 'vivía' are both imperfect: they paint a lasting state of childhood, not a one-time occurrence.
phrases.memoryHook: 'Era' sounds like 'era' (an age/period) in English — a whole stretch of time, not a single moment.

practiceItems.prompt: Translate: When I was a kid, I lived in a small town
practiceItems.answer: Cuando era niño, vivía en un pueblo pequeño

practiceItems.prompt: Cuando ___ niño, vivía en un pueblo pequeño.

phrases.target: Tenía ocho años cuando aprendí a nadar
phrases.native: I was eight years old when I learned to swim
phrases.phonetic: teh-NEE-ah OH-choh AH-nyos KWAN-doh ah-pren-DEE ah nah-DAR
phrases.vocabularyIntro: 'Tenía... años' is the standard way to state age in the past; 'aprendí' marks the single completed event of learning.

exampleSentence.target: Tenía ocho años cuando aprendí a nadar en el río.
exampleSentence.native: I was eight years old when I learned to swim in the river.

phrases.grammarNote: Age is always expressed with the imperfect ('tenía'), while the specific moment of achievement takes the preterite ('aprendí').
phrases.memoryHook: Picture an eight-year-old frozen mid-dive: the age (imperfect) is the freeze-frame, the dive (preterite) is the splash.

practiceItems.prompt: Translate: I was eight years old when I learned to swim
practiceItems.answer: Tenía ocho años cuando aprendí a nadar

practiceItems.prompt: Tenía ocho años cuando ___ a nadar.
¿Cuántos años tenías cuando aprendiste a nadar?

phrases.target: Íbamos todos los veranos a la casa de mis abuelos
phrases.native: We used to go every summer to my grandparents' house
phrases.phonetic: EE-bah-mos TOH-dohs los veh-RAH-nos ah lah KAH-sah deh mees ah-BWEH-los
phrases.vocabularyIntro: 'Íbamos' (imperfect of 'ir') expresses a repeated, habitual trip — something that happened again and again, not a single visit.

exampleSentence.target: Íbamos todos los veranos a la casa de mis abuelos en Oaxaca.
exampleSentence.native: We used to go every summer to my grandparents' house in Oaxaca.

phrases.grammarNote: Contrast this habitual 'íbamos todos los veranos' with the single-event preterite 'fui el verano pasado' (I went last summer) — same verb, opposite aspect.
phrases.memoryHook: 'Todos los veranos' (every summer) is the giveaway word for imperfect — routines love the imperfect.

practiceItems.prompt: Translate: We used to go every summer to my grandparents' house
practiceItems.answer: Íbamos todos los veranos a la casa de mis abuelos

practiceItems.prompt: ___ todos los veranos a la casa de mis abuelos.

practiceItems.answer: Íbamos a la casa de mis abuelos

phrases.target: Pero fui solo una vez el verano pasado
phrases.native: But I only went once last summer
phrases.phonetic: PEH-roh FWEE SOH-loh OO-nah VES el veh-RAH-noh pah-SAH-doh
phrases.vocabularyIntro: 'Fui' (preterite of 'ir') marks a single, completed trip with a specific, limited timeframe — 'el verano pasado' (last summer).

exampleSentence.target: Antes íbamos todos los veranos, pero fui solo una vez el verano pasado.
exampleSentence.native: We used to go every summer before, but I only went once last summer.

phrases.grammarNote: This phrase is the direct preterite counterpart to 'íbamos': one specific, finished trip instead of a repeated habit.
phrases.memoryHook: 'Una vez' (one time) locks the action into the preterite — a single countable event.

practiceItems.prompt: Translate: But I only went once last summer
practiceItems.answer: Pero fui solo una vez el verano pasado

practiceItems.prompt: Pero ___ solo una vez el verano pasado.

phrases.target: Mientras jugábamos en la calle, empezó a llover
phrases.native: While we were playing in the street, it started to rain
phrases.phonetic: mee-EN-tras hoo-GAH-bah-mos en lah KAH-yeh, em-peh-SOH ah yoh-VEHR
phrases.vocabularyIntro: 'Mientras' (while) introduces an ongoing imperfect background action; the preterite 'empezó' names the sudden interrupting event.

exampleSentence.target: Mientras jugábamos en la calle, empezó a llover de repente.
exampleSentence.native: While we were playing in the street, it suddenly started to rain.

phrases.grammarNote: This is the classic pattern: imperfect background ('jugábamos') + preterite interruption ('empezó'), linked by 'mientras'.
phrases.memoryHook: 'Mientras' means 'while' — a while is a stretch, so the verb after it stretches too (imperfect).

practiceItems.prompt: Translate: While we were playing in the street, it started to rain
practiceItems.answer: Mientras jugábamos en la calle, empezó a llover

practiceItems.prompt: Mientras jugábamos en la calle, ___ a llover.
¿Qué pasó mientras jugaban en la calle?

dialogue.scenario: Two friends are catching up and comparing where they grew up.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.line: Oye, nunca me habías contado. ¿Dónde creciste tú?
turns.native: Hey, you never told me. Where did you grow up?

turns.speaker: learner
hints: Cuando era niño, vivía en un pueblo pequeño
Crecí en un pueblo, pero ahora vivo en la ciudad

turns.speaker: npc
turns.line: Qué bonito. ¿Tenían alguna costumbre familiar de niños?
turns.native: How nice. Did you have any family custom as kids?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.cue: Describe a family custom from your childhood.
hints: Íbamos todos los veranos a la casa de mis abuelos
Todos los domingos comíamos en casa de la abuela

turns.speaker: npc
turns.line: Suena muy familiar. ¿Y pasó algo curioso alguna vez durante esos veranos?
turns.native: Sounds very familiar. And did anything funny ever happen during those summers?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.cue: Tell a short story about something that happened during those summers.
hints: Mientras jugábamos en la calle, empezó a llover
De repente, mi abuela nos llamó para cenar

turns.speaker: npc
turns.line: Ja, típico. ¿Y tú solías ir tan seguido como antes?
turns.native: Ha, typical. And did you used to go as often as before?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.cue: Say that, unlike before, you only went once last summer.
hints: Pero fui solo una vez el verano pasado
